# Royal Builders - LLM Access Guide

## Site Overview
Royal Builders is a Chennai-based construction, interior design, real estate, and building maintenance company established in 2010. We specialize in residential and commercial construction, luxury interiors, verified land sales, and professional building maintenance services across Chennai.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://royal-builders.in/

- Interior Design: https://royal-builders.in/interiors
- Real Estate & Land: https://royal-builders.in/real-estate
- Building Maintenance: https://royal-builders.in/maintenance
- Projects Portfolio: https://royal-builders.in/projects
- Contact: https://royal-builders.in/contact

## Services Offered
1. **Construction** - Residential homes, villas, apartments, commercial buildings, joint ventures, structural design
2. **Interiors** - Modular kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, false ceilings, wall panels, bedroom/living design
3. **Real Estate** - Residential land, commercial property, investment plots in North Chennai (Perambur, Manali, Thiruvottiyur, Ambattur)
4. **Maintenance** - Building repairs, water tank/sump cleaning, plumbing, electrical, fabrication, painting, AMC contracts
